scope: Complete declared same-host frozen lab catalog. Other study tests remain pending. Pooled windows are descriptive; no model/variant promotion, retuning, population or zero-day/superiority claim.
limitations: Source/service/path/load shift and sparse development V remain.
Report preexisting alarm state and alarm-window occupancy alongside starts. Zero new starts does not imply alarm-free operation.
Controlled campaign exposure is not packet maliciousness, proven worker occupancy or demonstrated denial. Service probes are separate impact evidence.
Include no-payload/failed/unscorable planned episodes from qualification ledgers when reporting all planned trials.
Unique reserved seed IDs and repeated same-host sessions are not independent environments. Unsupported paired-parent strata produce N/A.

attack_trial_accounting.scope: Payload onset proves a controlled campaign, not successful denial. Include ineffective trials; no-payload trials remain unscorable, not benign/hit/miss.

partial_mix_warning: All declared benign conditions have their fixed repetitions. Rates describe this same-host condition mixture; no model learning or population FPR guarantee.
attack_mix_warning: All declared campaign factor cells have their fixed repetitions. Rates describe this same-host exposure mixture; no model learning or successful-denial assertion.
probe_failure_interpretation: Existing acquisition policy: complete HTTP200 with integrity, before a 2s deadline; 1s socket operations may time out earlier. Failed/skipped includes HTTP errors, disconnects, incomplete reads, timeouts and scheduler skips, not only elapsed-deadline overruns. Counts/criteria are unchanged; reason breakdown is descriptive.

preserved_pre_schedule_interruption.scope: Original unscheduled setup is preserved as engineering history. No released or partly measured trial was restarted; all canonical trial outcomes retained. Host/engine interruption is disclosed, not an independent environment.

pending_study_tests: Separately declared compatible public slow/K/external qualification and frozen transfer.
Separate feature/inference cost and measured live detector latency evaluation.
uncertainty_interpretation: Frozen paired-parent bootstrap resamples observed recordings within declared strata, with seeds averaged inside sessions. Any available intervals are descriptive conditional same-host session variability, not independent environments, population guarantees or proof of superiority. Preserve N/A where unsupported.
